name: Collection Tracker Focus
voiceoverScript: Retro Vault Elite is built for collectors who want to keep the whole collection in one place.
Track what you own, what you still want, and the oddball titles that usually fall through the cracks.
It is made to feel faster and cleaner than juggling a spreadsheet and three different apps.
